cases.behavior: Supervisor 恢复测试加载真实应用时，不覆盖其他测试已经执行的源码覆盖率。
cases.reproduction: e76 在同一轮真实 Native 锁测试与 Supervisor 恢复测试中，将成功的 inspectNativeProjectLocks 调用记为零；Linux 原始 V8 数据显示同一源码 URL 分别对应 76915 与 20517 字符的编译结果。
cases.expected: 恢复案例继续核对真实应用失败、兄弟任务推进及仅重试原审查，锁测试的已执行函数仍有命中，原覆盖率门槛保持不变。
cases.forbidden: 全局 Node 源码加载器将不同编译结果按同一 URL 合并，覆盖已执行语句；或通过跳过恢复案例、删除断言、排除源码或降低门槛掩盖错误。
cases.rootCause: 恢复套件在 Vitest 进程中注册 esbuild 的 Node 加载器，磁盘应用的原生 require 与 Vite 编译对同一 .ts URL 上报不同的 V8 范围；它们被按 URL 合并。

requiredNames: preserves source coverage while Supervisor recovery loads the built application

cases.behavior: Supervisor Archive validates the original integration inputs before removing its integration worktree.
cases.rootCause: Early delivery finalization removed the worktree before Archive performed its last check-input validation, producing ENOENT after Specs had been applied.
cases.expected: Keep the integration directory through final input validation, complete the original delivery and cleanup once, and preserve the requested branch/worktree finish choice.
cases.forbidden: Delete the checked integration inputs before validating them, replay the delivery, or leave children unfinished after successful Archive.
cases.reproduction: PR539 branch and worktree delivery cases reproduced ENOENT locally. Both now assert integration still exists at the after-Specs boundary and is removed only after final Archive.
